sentences.en: The lion grew very fond of Shatraba.

sentences.ar: صاروا يقعدوا مع بعض كل يوم.
sentences.en: They began sitting together every day.

sentences.ar: الثور كان عاقل وبيحكي حكي حلو.
sentences.en: The ox was wise and spoke well.
Dimna became very unhappy about this.

sentences.ar: قال: أنا جبته وهلق صار أقرب مني.
sentences.en: He said: I brought him and now he is closer than me.

sentences.ar: قال له كليلة: إنت عملتها بإيدك.
sentences.en: Kalila said to him: you did this with your own hand.

sentences.ar: قال دمنة: واللي عملته بقدر أفكه.
sentences.en: Dimna said: and what I made I can undo.
